components: Many issues make object detection difficult, e.g., occlusion, cluttered background, and motion blur.
Among all of these, this paper focuses on the difficulty of detecting objects observed with different scales, which is called multi-scale object detection.
While the pyramid representation is essentially effective both for upsampling [1, 2, 3] and downsampling [4], image and feature scales are discretized, such as × 41 , × 12 , ×1, ×2, and ×4.
